wechat_groups.$comment: One WeChat copy file per group type. hashtag=true puts '#接龙' as the very first line (WeChat turns it into a 接龙 thread). show_venue=false replaces the venue with venue_replacement (for the nationwide group that only attends online).

public.label: 本地 IT 交流群（非会员）

schedule.$comment: House rule for every meetup: doors + networking from `doors`, talk (and the online stream) starts at `start`.
schedule.zh_start_note: 18:30 正式开讲（线上同步 18:30 开始）

handoff_naming.$comment: Global rule: every public copy file is named <channel>-post-<topic>-<date>.md. channel labels below; topic = event.topic (falls back to slug minus date); date = YYYY-MM-DD from the slug.

recap.$comment: Post-event LinkedIn recap. Prose in events/<slug>.json recap.linkedin; photos listed in recap.photos (first = lead image).
recap.next_line: If you would like to speak at a future CITANZ meetup, or just want to hear about the next one, follow CITANZ or get in touch.

cta.$comment: Every public post asks two things: what should we cover next, and do you want to speak. This is how next_topics gets evidence and how the speaker pipeline fills — the announcement posts drive almost no RSVPs (1 click on 2026-09-16), so their real job is discovery.
cta.linkedin_announcement: What would you like us to cover after this one? Comment below — and if you would like to speak at a future CITANZ meetup, get in touch.
cta.linkedin_recap: What should we cover next? Comment below — or put your hand up to speak.

cta.wechat: 💡 想听什么主题，或者自己想来讲一场 —— 群里直接说，或者私我
cta.meetup: Have a topic you would like to see covered, or would you like to speak at a future session? Comment on this event or message the organiser.
